items.summary: Legal disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Official Woot documentation proves API access mechanics only; current public terms do not evidence rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere remains conditional when it preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Compliance disposition: CONDITIONAL, not certification. Evidence records 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is healthy for configured properties; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked where compliance, security, or launch evidence is missing.

Data-quality and revenue disposition: registry, operational checkouts, analytics, SEO, AI usage, and revenue ingestion are green; revenue attribution is yellow because the 2026-09-21 Amazon report contains 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission that cannot be assigned to a site. Do not claim site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, or causal lift. Preserve unknowns and require new site links to use registered tracking IDs.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each site covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker; escalate incomplete packets to CTO at the existing deadline.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closed because direct evidence remains incomplete. Existing progress is limited to official Woot API/terms/support review, partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft site terms. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle covering rights, data flow, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.
